basic_info.description: Recently remodeled Noe Valley home featuring 3BR/2BA & 1,939 SqFt (per graphic artist)The main level has hardwood floors, a light-filled living room with a decorative fireplace, an updated kitchen (stainless steel appliances, quartz counters), 2 spacious BRs, a skylit office nook & a remodeled full bath. The lower level is a serene primary suite with a walk-in closet & spa-like ensuite bath. French doors & a separate side hallway provide dual access to the large, flat landscaped backyard with mature plantings & avocado treeperfect for entertaining. A 2-car garage with interior access & abundant storage offers ultimate convenience. With a Walk Score of 98, this prime location is a flat stroll to 24th St's vibrant shops, cafes & farmers market, plus Upper Noe Rec Ctr & Dolores Park. Near acclaimed dining, this urban oasis combines charm, comfort & unbeatable walkability.
